fusions.name: Dabbling Nip
fusions.desc: A darting peck at the first enemy in a line up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 water damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles to your target and deal 26 water damage, ignoring resistances, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of where you land, leaving them [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Water Off Feathers
fusions.desc: You take 25% less damage for 10 seconds, and you hop 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Pond Skater

riders.text: you cross it faster than open ground
and blows slide off you there
and you strike faster from it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you cross it 10% faster, from silver you have 6% more dodge chance there, and from gold you attack 6% faster there.
